description.p: An independent companion to OpenLinkHub, the device daemon by Nikola. It provides a native Qt 6 and KDE frontend — devices, dashboard, RGB, fan curves, LCD, macros, and settings — using your desktop and Kvantum widget theme.
This project is not affiliated with, endorsed by, or part of the official OpenLinkHub project.
Official website: openlinkhub.dev. Official source: github.com/jurkovic-nikola/OpenLinkHub.
First release of the KDE app for the OpenLinkHub service.

ul.li: Dashboard for temperatures, fans, pumps, and power supplies
Lighting, LCD images, fan profiles, headset sidetone, and equalizer
RGB editor, RGB cluster, and macros
Fan curves with the current temperature marked on the graph
Hold a fan or pump at a set speed, then return to its saved profile
System tray, including after the window is closed, with an option to start there
One window, reopened on the last page, with a sidebar that collapses to icons
Shortcuts for the window, lighting, and headset sidetone
System Monitor sensors for fans, the pump, and the power supply
